hook_card.text:
الخطوط فالفخاد والجناب؟
السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت

shots.vo_line: شوفي فيا… خطوط طوال، شي حمرين وشي بيضين. من نهار نقصتي
shots.row: The thigh character (a Pixar-style walking hip and thigh in pink shorts with clear red and white stretch marks, sweet face on the upper thigh) sitting sad on a gym bench
shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while slowly rubbing the lines on her thigh. She lets out a heavy sigh, sagging on the bench, then lifts her sad eyes to the camera and keeps pointing at her lines, blinking and breathing. Static camera. shots.vo_line: ولا زدتي فالوزن وأنا هكا. ونتي ولّيتي كتلبسي الصاية الطويلة حتى فالصيف.

shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while gazing longingly at the short skirts in the window. She sighs, tugs her long skirt down and looks at it sadly, then turns to the camera with a small helpless shrug as the flowers keep swaying in the breeze. Static camera. shots.vo_line: المشكل ماشي فوقي، المشكل لتحت: ملي الوزن طلع وهبط بالزربة، أنا تجبدت وتقطعت من لتحت.

shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while finishing her step and pointing down at the cut-away on her thigh. Inside it the pink threads stretch tight and snap one by one with tiny sparks; she winces at each snap, then keeps explaining with worried eyes and small bounces. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. shots.vo_line: ونتي؟ كل نهار الرياضة… العضلة تشدات، ولكن أنا بقيت كيف ما أنا. القهوة مع السكر… حكيتيني حتى حمّرت. الكريمة

shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while glancing at the muscle character, who flexes from pose to pose, laughing. She rolls her eyes, then winces as the bowl character scrubs her hip with the brush in quick strokes, and keeps squirming while he keeps flexing. Static camera. shots.vo_line: ب250 درهم… بقات فوقي. كلشي من برا… والجرح لتحت.
shots.row: A muscle character flexing next to her while she stays the same; a coffee bowl scrubbing her red; a cream tube sitting on top of her like a hat
shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while pointing up at the cream tube on top of her, which wobbles but stays put. The bowl character stops scrubbing and the muscle character lowers his arms to watch her; she sighs, droops and keeps patting her thigh sadly, blinking. Static camera. shots.frame_issue: Same frame as s04: human-looking muscle character.

shots.vo_line: أنا خاصني اللي يدخل لتحت. غوتيفا: سيروم خفيف، كنشربو دغيا وما كيلزقش. زيت أركان وفيتامين E كيغذيوني وكيعاونوني نبرا،

shots.h3_prompt: The thigh character talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while looking up as the golden drop falls from the dropper onto her hip and sinks in. A soft golden glow swirls down her thigh; she giggles, hugs herself and keeps taking small happy steps in place. The bottle keeps its exact shape and label, standing still. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Two droppers: the bottle keeps its own dropper cap while a second dropper floats above her. Minor: label small print garbled ('BOUGE ESOSTANTES') and the Arabic line slightly off; brand and headline correct.

shots.vo_line: والألوفيرا كتبرد الحمورية. ماشي بحال الرياضة، كيخدم عليا أنا. ما كيحكنيش بحال القهوة، وما كيبقاش فوقي بحال الكريمة. دقيقتين

shots.vo_line: الصباح والعشية… فـ30 يوم الحمرين خفّو، فـ60 البيضين قربو للون ديالي، وفـ90 يوم… الصاية القصيرة رجعات. وخلي القهوة للفطور.
